QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] School In Danger 1
QuestInfo.0: Take Elwin's call concerning the increasing dark energy around the school.
QuestInfo.1: Elwin says something has happened and wants you to come to the Library for the details. Talk to him at the Library on the 2nd floor.
QuestInfo.2: He says all the emotions toward student teacher's caused three Dust Zones to appear at once.
